description: This file is a shell script for testing Git push options and hook configurations. It sets up hooks, modifies configurations, performs git push commands with various options, and verifies expected behaviors related to push options, hooks, and refs in a Git repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: A macro or function to define a test case expecting success, runs the provided shell commands and checks for success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: A macro or function to run commands expecting failure, used for negative test cases.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks if the output contains a specific pattern.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the actual output to an expected output.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Compares the current refs in the repository to a given set of refs.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Formats the expected output and saves it for comparison.
